While TiO2 is listed as the enrichment method (which is the standard for phosphoproteomics, hence the PPA:0000292 label), it is used here specifically to enrich peptide-RNA adducts. The labeling mentioned (13C) refers to the RNA, not the protein. The protein identity was confirmed via top-down analysis, but the primary assay for cross-linking is bottom-up (trypsin digestion).
